verdict.rationale: Vue's official site has a first-party 'Tutorial' section (vue-docs-11) alongside 'Examples' (vue-docs-12), so a learning tutorial exists. The evidence pack only gives these as navigation titles, though, and never shows that the tutorial runs interactively in the browser without local setup. missing for 10: evidence that the tutorial is interactive and in-browser (live code editing and preview), evidence that no local install is needed, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the tutorial experience.
